lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Where the silver river flows,
Underneath the weeping willow tree,
Time carves paths in stone,
Whispers of a thousand years.
[Chorus]
The moon is a ghost in the sky,
Watching the petals fall like snow,
A thousand miles from home,
The heart finds its way back home.
[Verse]
Silk threads weave through time,
Mountains stand in silent prayer,
Fading shadows stretch long,
In the garden of old dreams.
[Chorus]
The moon is a ghost in the sky,
Watching the petals fall like snow,
A thousand miles from home,
The heart finds its way back home.
[Bridge]
Petals fall in the wind,
Mountains rise in the mist.
[Chorus]
The moon is a ghost in the sky,
Watching the petals fall like snow,
A thousand miles from home,
The heart finds its way back home.
[Outro]
